claim_text: Canonical ALW uses per-axis mean-square position normalization and squared log-ratio shape terms
evidence_requirement: Formula, pseudocode, implementation, and unit tests must agree
decision_note: Enabled by canonical implementation and exact unit tests

claim_text: Canonical ALW is non-negative for positive-width and positive-height boxes before numerical clamping
evidence_requirement: Formal derivation plus finite-value and non-negativity tests
decision_note: Enabled for canonical ALW

claim_text: Canonical ALW is symmetric
evidence_requirement: Formal proof plus swap-input unit test
decision_note: Applies to ALW only

claim_text: Canonical ALW is dimensionless and jointly scale-invariant
evidence_requirement: Formal proof plus joint-rescaling tests across scales and aspect ratios
decision_note: Applies before numerical clamp and to ALW only

claim_text: SA-ALW is a target-conditioned extension of ALW using clipped beta and position-weight schedules
evidence_requirement: Canonical code, pseudocode, clipping tests, and frozen train-derived bounds must agree
decision_note: Reference endpoints and sensitivity are preregistered; enable only after D1 bounds and G1

claim_text: SA-ALW adds no learnable parameters
evidence_requirement: Parameter-count parity under identical detector construction and checkpoint audit
decision_note: Synthetic detector smoke confirms exact parameter-count parity; do not rewrite as parameter-free

claim_text: SA-ALW changes assignment behavior relative to canonical ALW
evidence_requirement: Assignment-change rate decomposed into threshold, top-k, and cross-GT conflict causes by scale bin
decision_note: AI-TOD train-anchor sample confirms nonzero threshold-dominated changes; TinyPerson/full frozen-train artifact still required

claim_text: SA-ALW rebalances center and shape optimization across target scales
evidence_requirement: Per-scale center-term and shape-term gradient norms under matched batches
decision_note: Synthetic position-ranking reversal is technical only; do not claim removal of noisy gradients

claim_text: SA-ALW improves mean COCO AP over the verified direct predecessor
evidence_requirement: Three matched seeds, original-image evaluator, public D1, same selector and budget, paired image bootstrap CI
decision_note: A4 falsified the primary claim: mean delta -0.001286 and AP 95% CI [-0.002939,0.001277]; Paper A performance work closed NO-GO

claim_text: SA-ALW improves AP75 over the verified direct predecessor
evidence_requirement: Three matched seeds and paired original-image uncertainty for AP75
decision_note: Mean AP75 delta is +0.001684 but 95% CI [-0.001778,0.004946] crosses zero; claim disabled under frozen rule

claim_text: The central SA-ALW gain transfers to a second public benchmark
evidence_requirement: Matched evidence on AI-TOD-v2 with the same frozen method and evaluator contract
decision_note: Not pursued after the D1 primary AP NO-GO; no external diagnostic or matrix authorized

claim_text: Assignment plus regression is the justified full placement for SA-ALW
evidence_requirement: Matched assignment-only, regression-only, and joint ablation with fixed IoU-NMS
decision_note: WP04 is closed by the A4 NO-GO; no new placement training is authorized

claim_text: Both adaptive schedules contribute under a clean canonical ALW denominator
evidence_requirement: A3-A6 component ablation on validation and frozen conference matrix
decision_note: WP04 is closed by the A4 NO-GO; negative evidence is retained without a rescue ablation

claim_text: SA-ALW has a defensible novelty boundary relative to closest scale-aware prior work
evidence_requirement: Primary-source related-work matrix including SAFit and verified IGWD/GCD metadata
decision_note: Only the exact center-plus-log-shape formulation and separately placed clipped schedules are defensible; no component-level priority claim

claim_text: Dataset counts, provenance, split grouping, and scale statistics are accurate
evidence_requirement: Dataset card, sequence-disjoint manifest, hashes, source-vs-processed counts, and train-only statistics
decision_note: Do not describe 1374 augmented files as independent sources

claim_text: SA-ALW is the first scale-adaptive Gaussian metric
evidence_requirement: Not permitted at G0; systematic novelty audit would still require narrower wording
decision_note: SAFit and other target-scale-adaptive measures make any broad first claim indefensible

claim_text: SA-ALW is parameter-free
evidence_requirement: Not permitted; use no additional learnable parameters only after audit
decision_note: Remove from submission manuscript

claim_text: SA-ALW is state of the art or consistently superior
evidence_requirement: Not permitted without comprehensive public benchmark evidence
decision_note: Remove from submission manuscript

claim_text: SA-ALW is symmetric or jointly scale-invariant
evidence_requirement: False for target-conditioned schedules based on absolute target scale
decision_note: ALW-only properties must not be transferred to SA-ALW

claim_text: SA-ALW is detector-agnostic
evidence_requirement: Not permitted unless a second detector integration passes G1 and G2 and has matched results
decision_note: Omit if RetinaNet integration is not audited

claim_text: Legacy tile-level or reused-test numbers support a submission claim
evidence_requirement: Legacy evidence is diagnostic only by scope contract
decision_note: No exception
